openQuestions.question: tests/e2e/fast-path.spec.ts blocks **/MuseumCanvas* and acknowledges only the JS chunk errors. A CSS module in the museum chunk makes the blocked load also log 'Unable to preload CSS for .../MuseumCanvas-*.css', which trips the console guard (seen with the first draft of this WP). Should R8 acknowledge that message too?
openQuestions.default: WP-08 keeps the stage styles inline (environment/stage.ts stageStyle) and has no MuseumCanvas.module.css, so the chunk is one JS file and the suite is green. WP-26 can draw the vignette as an inline-styled sibling div instead of .stage::after.

openQuestions.question: ARCHITECTURE §10.3 read literally ignores height-only resizes on fine pointers too. Is re-measuring --stage-h on every resize for fine pointers (desktop window height changes) acceptable?
openQuestions.default: Fine pointers re-measure on any resize; coarse pointers on a width change or a height change of 20% or more (environment/stage.ts, unit-tested).

openQuestions.question: compilePending is held from ExhibitFrame mount until the slot shows its final content (the revealed exhibit, or the compiled crate), not only from the lazy component resolving. Accept this stricter reading of the brief?
openQuestions.default: Held from mount, so ready (ARCHITECTURE §13.4) can never fire between mount and the chunk resolving.

openQuestions.question: configureTextBuilder also gets useWorker: false: troika's typesetting worker loads code with importScripts(blob:), which the CSP's script-src 'self' blocks inside a blob worker. Keep main-thread typesetting, or add blob: to script-src?

notes: Merge after WP-06, WP-07, WP-10 (already in) and before WP-09. The branch is based on dfd4381; the WP-08 diff applied cleanly onto the integration tip 7658245 in a scratch export (no file overlaps with the F-M1 fixes), where typecheck, lint, unit tests, build, budgets (including the F-010 entry fingerprints), check-copy and the full Playwright suite (133 passed, 99 skipped, 0 failed, all projects) were green. The WIP commit 5ae2007 was folded into the three Output commits (local branch only, never pushed). For WP-09: each slot is a group 'slot-<id>' with an invisible hit box mesh 'hit-<id>' (standard 0.9 x 1.85 x 0.9) for screenPos; Scene picks the visitor's stop from progress.track and Math.round(progress.current) (environment/useVisitorStop.ts), so exhibits mount ahead while walking; case clicks call openStory(id, { source: 'case' }) on the settled stop, else travelTo(id); the canvas starts at the lobby pose (position and rotation) until CameraRig moves it; sections still need pointer-events: none for 3D hover and click (WP-09 CSS). Remove the skip from greybox.spec.ts test 2 when goTo lands. Implementation notes: drei ContactShadows re-renders its pass after every React re-render (its frame counter lives in the component body), so it sits behind a memo (PlinthShadow) and renders once per mount; the crate gets the pass too. Fog must attach to the scene (Scene.tsx top level), not a group. The fixtures are 7 instanced draws (plinths, base strips, wide plinth, wall panels, desk, case edges, cases); the shell is one merged mesh; floors are one mesh per room.
